name: codex-claude-ctx-monitor
description: Track Codex and Claude Code context usage in the VS Code status bar.

agentTokenStatus.sessionsRoot.description: Optional absolute path to the Codex sessions directory. Leave empty to use ~/.codex/sessions.

agentTokenStatus.claudeRoot.description: Optional absolute path to the Claude Code home directory. Leave empty to use ~/.claude.

agentTokenStatus.refreshIntervalMs.description: How often to refresh token usage from local agent session files.

agentTokenStatus.enableClaudeOAuthUsage.markdownDescription: Read Claude subscription rate limits directly from the OAuth usage endpoint, so they also work when Claude Code is used only through the VS Code panel (where the status line never runs). Uses the access token Claude Code already stored; the refresh token is never touched, and an expired token is skipped rather than refreshed. On macOS the first read may raise a Keychain authorization prompt. **Pro/Max subscriptions only** — the endpoint refuses `team` and `enterprise` accounts, and the extension then stops asking and falls back to the status line bridge (`scripts/usage-cache.sh`). Turn this off to skip the credential read entirely.
